$comment: The know-how each Krizaka product proves — the provable sentences of krizaka.com (messages site.products.knowhow.*). Structure of the products (name, url, status, repo) comes from @krizaka/ui/sites; this file only holds words. A product listed here but not yet in the published @krizaka/ui/sites carries a `fallback` until the package knows it.

orazaka.proof: Every request crosses a deterministic pipeline to the best local model: your documents, your models, your network — nothing leaves.

orochia.proof: Uploads go straight to the CDN over Tus, an adaptive transcoder encodes, playback uses signed HLS links that expire after five minutes, and every transaction settles through escrow.

yasakia.proof: The position is rounded to about 1 km before it is stored, and the database answers the radius and matches who you are with who you seek — nearby, never exact.

yororis.proof: A listening space with a face and a voice — under construction: nothing is deployed, nothing is offered.

yomizaka.proof: A lease checked rule by rule against the law in force on a date, a PDF examined for signs of editing: every finding quotes its passage, every check is a traced Orazaka run.
